en_title: Apparent Leaked Footage Shows Canceled Assassin's Creed Game Set in Qin Dynasty China
cn_title: 秦朝《刺客信条》疑似取消，画面流出
subtitle: 伞下的秦汉风云
opus_summary: 据报道，育碧曾与腾讯合作开发《刺客信条：命运》，设定在秦汉交替时期，项目似乎已取消。疑似泄露的原型画面展示了围城战和伞形武器，游戏似乎面向现代主机与PC。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft was apparently making another Assassin’s Creed game set in ancient China, except this one was a full-fat AC with a massive open world and a fancy umbrella weapon. According to a new report, the game was called Assassin’s Creed Destiny.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧似乎曾开发过另一款以中国古代为背景的《刺客信条》游戏，不过这次是完整规模的作品，拥有庞大的开放世界，还有一把花哨的伞形武器。据一篇新报道，这款游戏名为《刺客信条：命运》。

paragraphs.en: Assassin’s Creed Jade will explore the same setting, targeting mobile. Destiny’s prototype footage appears to be aimed at modern consoles and PC instead.
paragraphs.cn: 面向移动平台的《刺客信条：玉》也将采用中国古代背景。相比之下，从《命运》的原型画面来看，这款游戏似乎面向现代主机和PC。

paragraphs.en: Destiny was reportedly set during 206 BCE, where the Qin dynasty made way for the Han dynasty after a brutal civil war. The game likely would have focused on Liu Bang’s rise to power.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，《命运》的故事设定在公元前206年，秦朝在残酷的内战后被汉朝取代。游戏很可能会围绕刘邦夺取政权的历程展开。

paragraphs.en: MP1st found the footage in developer portfolios. According to the report, the game was supposed to be a partnership between Ubisoft and Tencent, the Chinese conglomerate that owns huge portions of the games industry, including a 25% stake in Vantage Studios, a subsidiary that oversees some of Ubisoft’s biggest IPs.
paragraphs.cn: MP1st在开发者的作品集中发现了这些画面。据报道，这款游戏原计划由育碧与腾讯合作开发。腾讯这家中国综合性企业在游戏行业持有大量股权，其中包括Vantage Studios的25%股份；这家育碧子公司负责管理育碧旗下的一些头部IP。

paragraphs.en: The footage shows a hooded assassin battling through a siege headed up by warlord Xiang Yu, before switching to greybox testing environments for combat abilities. There’s a spinning umbrella weapon shown at one point.
paragraphs.cn: 画面中，一名戴着兜帽的刺客在项羽率军发起的围城战中奋战，随后镜头切换到用于测试战斗能力的灰盒环境。其中一处画面展示了一把旋转的伞形武器。

paragraphs.en: Another snippet suggests players would have been able to choose between a male and female character, or it could have done the Shadows thing of having dual protagonists. Yin-yangs and ink brushes are used to tie the UI into the setting thematically.
paragraphs.cn: 另一段片段显示，玩家或许可以在男性和女性角色之间选择，也可能是像《刺客信条：影》那样采用双主角设计。游戏界面运用了阴阳图案和水墨笔触，让视觉主题与故事背景相呼应。

paragraphs.en: While Destiny was seemingly cancelled, Assassin’s Creed Jade is still in development. The last we heard about it was that it was delayed to 2025 . Considering it’s 2026 now, it’s probably safe to assume they’re having some issues getting the mobile game off the ground, which is ironic for a series about assassins who love rooftops.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然《命运》似乎已被取消，但《刺客信条：玉》仍在开发中。我们上次听到的消息是，它已延期至2025年。考虑到现在已经是2026年，大概可以推测，这款手游的开发推进遇到了一些问题。一个讲述刺客热衷于飞檐走壁的系列，如今却迟迟无法起步，倒也有些讽刺。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere in the world of hidden blades, leaps of faith, and stylish hoods, Assassin’s Creed Hexe is the next major game in the series. If leaks are to be believed, that’s got its own development issues, mind you. One report suggests Assassin’s Creed Hexe developers decided to rework the game, removing magical abilities from the mix.
paragraphs.cn: 再看看这个充满袖剑、信仰之跃和帅气兜帽的系列的其他动向：《刺客信条：Hexe》将是系列下一款重磅作品。不过，如果爆料可信，这款游戏的开发也遇到了问题。有报道称，《刺客信条：Hexe》的开发团队决定重新调整游戏，移除其中的魔法能力。

paragraphs.en: Hexe's game director Benoit Richer recently departed the project for reasons unknown. That departure followed the exit of Clint Hocking, Hexe's creative director , sparking the beginning of a major internal reshuffle at the top of the franchise that saw Ubisoft veteran Jean Guesdon ascend to become Assassin's Creed Head of Content.
paragraphs.cn: 《刺客信条：Hexe》的游戏总监Benoit Richer近日退出了该项目，原因不明。在他之前，该作创意总监Clint Hocking也已离开。接连的离职拉开了系列内部高层大规模调整的序幕，育碧资深开发者Jean Guesdon升任《刺客信条》内容负责人。
